items.text: The arcade game Pac-Man was released on May 22, 1980.
items.question: Where was the first Pac-Man machine you played, and who did you play with?
items.source_quote: May 22 – Pac-Man, the best-selling arcade game of all time, is released.

items.text: On February 22, 1980, at the Winter Olympics in Lake Placid, New York, the United States Olympic hockey team defeated the Soviet Union in the Miracle on Ice.
items.question: Where were you when the U.S. hockey team beat the Soviet Union at Lake Placid, and who did you watch it with?
source_quote: February 13 – The XIII Winter Olympics open in Lake Placid, New York.
February 22 – The United States Olympic Hockey Team defeats the Soviet Union in the medal round of the Winter Olympics, in the Miracle on Ice.

items.text: Kenny Rogers's "Lady", written by Lionel Richie, reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in November 1980 and stayed there six weeks, tied for the year's longest run.
items.question: Where were you living when Kenny Rogers's "Lady" was on the radio, and who did you dance with to it?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1980, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations, respectively. During the year, 17 different singles spent time at number one.
Kenny Rogers gained his first Hot 100 number one in November 1980 with "Lady".
its six weeks atop the Hot 100 tied for the year's longest run at number one.

items.text: The Cable News Network, CNN, launched on June 1, 1980.
items.question: Who in your house was the first to keep CNN on all day, and where were you living then?
items.source_quote: June 1 – The Cable News Network (CNN) is officially launched.
